Professional Roofing Services in Belmont, California

Your roof is one of the most important systems protecting your Belmont home. Between seasonal rain, strong sun exposure, coastal moisture, wind, and changing temperatures, Bay Area roofs need to be installed correctly and maintained with materials suited to the local climate.

Roof Express provides professional residential roofing services throughout Belmont, CA and the San Mateo County area, including complete roof replacements, roof repairs, asphalt shingle roofing, low-slope roofing, skylight work, gutters, ventilation, and preventative roof maintenance.

Whether you own an older Belmont home that needs a complete reroof or you’ve discovered a leak after heavy rain, our team can inspect the roof, identify the affected areas, and provide a clear proposal for the recommended work.

Roof Replacement in Belmont, CA

A roof replacement is more than installing new shingles over an existing structure. A quality roofing system begins with properly evaluating the roof deck and addressing vulnerable areas before the finished roofing material is installed.

For qualifying asphalt-shingle projects, Roof Express can install premium CertainTeed Landmark® Pro roofing systems.

Our typical full roof replacement process may include removal of existing roofing materials, inspection of the exposed roof deck, replacement of damaged decking when required, installation of synthetic underlayment, additional waterproofing at critical areas, new flashing as specified, installation of the selected roofing system, ventilation work where applicable, and complete job-site cleanup.

The exact system is determined by the home’s roof design, existing conditions, applicable requirements, and the approved project scope.

CertainTeed Landmark® Pro Asphalt Shingles

Architectural asphalt shingles are a popular option for Belmont homeowners because they combine durability with an attractive dimensional appearance.

Roof Express installs CertainTeed Landmark® Pro shingles for homeowners looking for an upgraded architectural roofing system. Depending on the specific product and color selected, homeowners can choose from a variety of styles designed to complement both traditional and contemporary Bay Area homes.

For projects where energy performance is an important consideration, Landmark® PRO Solaris® options may also be available. Product availability and applicable ratings should always be confirmed for the specific shingle selected.

50-Year Manufacturer Warranty + 25-Year Roof Express Workmanship Warranty

A roof is a long-term investment, so the installation behind the material matters.

On eligible complete shingle roofing systems, Roof Express can provide applicable CertainTeed manufacturer warranty coverage, including qualifying enhanced warranty options, along with our 25-year workmanship warranty when included in the roofing agreement.

Manufacturer coverage varies by product and roofing system, so the final contract and manufacturer warranty documentation determine the exact coverage applicable to each project.

Roof Repair in Belmont

Not every roofing problem requires complete replacement.

If your roof still has useful service life remaining, a targeted repair may be the appropriate solution. Roof Express performs roof inspections and repairs for common problems such as leaks around penetrations, deteriorated flashing, missing or damaged shingles, pipe and vent penetrations, skylight areas, roof-to-wall transitions, drainage issues, and localized storm or weather damage.

The first step is determining where water is actually entering the roofing system. The visible stain inside a home isn’t always directly underneath the exterior source of the leak.

Our team evaluates the surrounding roofing system before recommending the repair scope.

Low-Slope & Flat Roofing in Belmont

Many Bay Area properties combine pitched asphalt-shingle sections with low-slope or flat roof areas.

These sections require roofing systems specifically designed for lower slopes. Roof Express installs multi-layer modified bitumen roofing assemblies for appropriate low-slope applications.

A typical replacement can involve complete tear-off, roof-deck inspection, preparation of the substrate, installation of the specified multi-layer roofing assembly, proper treatment of penetrations and transitions, flashing work, and finishing of perimeter details.

For homes containing both pitched and low-slope sections, we can develop a combined roofing scope so transitions between the different systems receive proper attention.

Skylight Replacement During a Reroof

A complete roof replacement can also be an ideal time to evaluate existing skylights.

Because the surrounding roofing and flashing are already being replaced, homeowners may choose to replace aging skylights at the same time rather than disturb a relatively new roofing system several years later.

Roof Express can install new skylights and integrate the appropriate flashing and waterproofing into the new roof system. Existing opening dimensions, roof configuration, skylight specifications, and project requirements are reviewed before installation.

Gutters, Downspouts & Roof Drainage

Even an excellent roofing system depends on effective drainage.

Roof Express can address gutters and downspouts as part of a larger roofing project when included in the project scope. Proper drainage helps move rainwater away from vulnerable roof edges and building components.

During an inspection, we can also identify visible drainage conditions that may contribute to standing water, overflow, or deterioration around roof edges.

Roofing for Belmont’s Hillside Homes

Belmont’s varied terrain means roofing projects can differ significantly from one property to another.

Steep roof pitches, multiple roof elevations, limited driveway or street access, landscaping, neighboring properties, skylights, chimneys, and combinations of pitched and low-slope roofing can all affect project planning.

That’s why an on-site roof inspection is important. Rather than relying only on a generic price per square foot, Roof Express evaluates the actual roof configuration and prepares the scope around the property.

Our Roofing Process

A typical Roof Express project begins with a free consultation and roof inspection. We evaluate the roof and document relevant conditions before preparing a written proposal.

Once the project is approved, our team coordinates scheduling, materials, property protection, tear-off, roof-deck inspection, installation, cleanup, and final project documentation according to the agreed scope.

For projects requiring a building permit, permit responsibilities and applicable fees are identified in the proposal or contract.

Why Belmont Homeowners Choose Roof Express

Roof Express is a California licensed roofing and general contractor serving homeowners throughout the San Francisco Bay Area.

Our focus is straightforward: premium materials, careful installation, transparent project scopes, and long-term roofing protection.

From a small leak repair to a complete CertainTeed asphalt-shingle replacement, we approach the roof as a complete system—not simply the visible surface material.

How Much Does a New Roof Cost in Belmont, CA?

Roof replacement prices vary considerably from one Belmont property to another.

Important cost factors include roof size, pitch and complexity, number of existing roofing layers, decking condition, selected roofing material, skylights, flashing requirements, accessibility, disposal requirements, ventilation, gutters, and permit requirements.

For that reason, the most useful way to determine the cost of your project is through an inspection and property-specific estimate.

Roof Express offers free roofing estimates, allowing homeowners to understand the recommended scope before deciding how to proceed.

Frequently Asked Questions About Roofing in Belmont

How long does a roof replacement take?
 Many residential roofing projects can be completed within several working days, but the actual duration depends on roof size, complexity, weather, material availability, inspections, and the amount of decking or structural repair discovered after tear-off.

Can you replace a roof while homeowners remain in the house?
 In many cases, yes. Roofing work creates substantial daytime noise and vibration, so homeowners should plan accordingly.

Do you replace damaged plywood?
 When the existing roof is removed, accessible decking can be inspected. Damaged decking identified during the project can be replaced according to the terms and pricing established in the contract.

Can you install a new skylight during roof replacement?
 Yes. Coordinating skylight replacement with a reroof can allow the new skylight and surrounding roofing components to be integrated as part of the new system.

Do you work on both shingle and flat roofs?
 Yes. Roof Express works with asphalt-shingle roofing and appropriate low-slope roofing systems, including properties containing both roof types.

Do you provide roofing warranties?
 Warranty coverage depends on the specific system and contract. Roof Express offers a 25-year workmanship warranty on qualifying shingle roof replacement projects, while manufacturer warranty coverage depends on the selected roofing products and eligibility requirements.

Schedule a Free Roof Estimate in Belmont, CA

If you’re considering roof replacement in Belmont, dealing with a roof leak, or simply want to understand the condition of your existing roof, Roof Express can inspect the property and provide a professional recommendation.
